name: How long does a kitchen lighting installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen lighting installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen lighting installation depends on its complexity. A simple replacement of existing fixtures might take a few hours. A more extensive project involving new wiring, multiple recessed lights, or specialty lighting could take a few days. We will provide a time estimate tailored to your specific project during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen lighting installation time varies; simple replacements take hours, while extensive projects can take days.
